overview_description.description: Hyperexponential is a pricing decision intelligence (PDI) software provider for the commercial insurance sector. Its platform enables insurers to leverage large and alternative datasets, develop and refine rating tools rapidly, employ sophisticated machine-learning approaches to price risk and make data-driven pricing decisions at the portfolio and individual level.

about_short_description.short_description: Hyperexponential is a provider of pricing decision intelligence (PDI) software for the commercial insurance sector.

product.name: hx Renew
product.description: A cloud-based pricing and underwriting platform for commercial insurers and reinsurers to build, deploy, and manage complex pricing tools and raters.

product.name: hx AI
product.description: A suite of AI-powered tools that automate data ingestion and assist actuaries in building pricing models faster within the insurance pricing workflow.

product.name: Reinsurance Model Template
product.description: A scalable, customizable treaty reinsurance model template within hx Renew that accelerates the deployment of Excess of Loss (XoL) treaty models.

product.name: Data Integrations for hx Renew
product.description: API-driven and flexible data integration capabilities that connect diverse internal and external data sources to the hx Renew platform for enhanced pricing and underwriting workflows.

identifier.value: Training and Certification for hx Renew

product.name: Training and Certification for hx Renew
product.description: Structured training programs and certification exams to develop proficiency in using the hx Renew platform and its APIs for pricing model development.

product.name: hyperexponential pricing and underwriting platform
product.description: AI-native pricing and underwriting software platform used by insurers to build and operate pricing tools.
